units.translation: Thus I emended what is written in M in the first hand as δικαίους [just men] (ou in a correction), with a superscription by an ancient hand, which is δικαίως [justly].

Without the article

where Triclinius correctly has ἐπραξάμην [I exacted]: ἀπήτησα [I demanded], that is, the vengeance which I exacted upon her.
